description: Role-level value exchanges. Legal fund, holding-company, manager, and portfolio-company entities remain distinct in financial records; arrows do not imply personal receipt of funds.

relationTypes.name: Financial
relationTypes.description: Capital obligations and cash flows through the relevant legal entities.

relations.name: Explains the desired ownership transition
relations.description: The founder shares objectives and authorized evidence with the investment representative; evidence access does not create a financing commitment.

relations.name: Presents a milestone and financing need
relations.description: The growth founder supplies an operating case and negotiates rights and alternatives subject to the relevant fund mandate.

relations.name: Commits to a fund represented by the manager
relations.description: Role-level relationship: accepted capital commitments and calls belong to the legal fund and administrator, not to an individual investment professional.

relations.name: Coordinates approved company financing
relations.description: The manager representative coordinates capital deployed by the relevant investment vehicle; seller proceeds, company cash, debt, and reserve plans are separate.

relations.name: Coordinates the active ownership partnership
relations.description: Investment and operating colleagues connect management to support and governance within the agreed company decision rights.

relations.name: Provides agreed company performance evidence
relations.description: Management supplies company-scoped reporting and material issue updates; it does not grant blanket access to all company customer data.

relations.name: Provides reviewed fund information through responsible service teams
relations.description: The manager relationship is serviced by finance, administrators, and authorized portals; reports identify the vehicle and investor calculation basis.

relations.name: Coordinates approved fund distributions
relations.description: Role-level relationship: distributions flow from the legal fund through authorized banking and administration processes, not personally from the investment professional.

relations.name: Agrees continuing responsibilities or succession
relations.description: A founder may remain in management or leave under an agreed handover; the personas represent different decision contexts and can be the same person.
